items.rationale: The product, Cal-Rise FG 25KGBG, is a chemical leavening agent composed of calcium acid pyrophosphate and monocalcium phosphate. These are both phosphate compounds used in food applications for leavening. The nearest ruling, N330806, classifies a product called 'Magnesium with Rosin' as a chemical compound used in industrial applications, and while it is not identical, it is classified under the same heading (3824.99.93.97) for chemical substances not otherwise specified. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character of the product is determined by its chemical composition and function as a leavening agent, which aligns with the classification of similar chemical compounds under 3824.99.93.97.

The product is a food supplement in powder form, composed entirely of creatine monohydrate, with no added sugars, proteins, or other ingredients. It is intended for consumption as a dietary supplement to enhance physical performance. The ruling N326135 classifies a similar food supplement from Taiwan under 2106.90.99.98, which is the most specific and directly applicable code. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character of the product is determined by its function as a food supplement, not by its form or packaging.

The product, IPS Ivocolor Essence 1.8g E22 Basic Yellow, is a powder stain/glaze material used for dental ceramic applications. It is composed of silicone dioxide and inorganic pigments and is used to stain dental restorations. This aligns with the description of 'prepared pigments, prepared opacifiers and prepared colors' in heading 3207.10.00.00, which is supported by the past ruling N344803, which classified similar dental application substances under this heading. The specific description of the product as a dental pigment aligns with this heading, and it is more specific than broader headings such as 3207.40.50.00.

The product is peat, which is specifically classified under heading 2703.00.00.00. The peat is used as a growing medium, and the presence of peat moss and processed bark in the formulations confirms its classification as peat. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character of the product is determined by its material, which is peat.

The product Desmoflex PU is a polyurethane-based waterproofing membrane used for long-term waterproofing, which aligns with the description of the SILCOR® 900HA Part A & Part B in ruling N329169, classified under 3214.10.00.20. This code is for waterproofing systems, and the product's function as a waterproofing membrane and its polyurethane base make it a direct match. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies here, as the specific description of a waterproofing system beats more general categories.

The product is a set of four polyvinyl chloride (PVC) automotive floor mats designed to fit specific vehicle models and provide comprehensive coverage for the interior floor. The ruling N344712 directly supports this classification, as it involves similar mats (part number JD888YY-BK1-3P-ML) classified under 8708.29.51.60. The General Rule of Interpretation (specific description over general) and the preference for past rulings on the same product type justify this choice.

Ursodiol (Ursodeoxycholic Acid) is a bile acid used in the treatment of primary biliary cholangitis (PBC). The nearest past ruling, N318358, classifies Colestipol Hydrochloride Tablets (a bile acid sequestrant) under 3004.90.92.20. Both products are bile acid derivatives used in medical treatment, and the ruling directly supports the classification of Ursodiol under the same code. The General Rule of Interpretation (specific description beats general) applies here, as the ruling provides a specific classification for a similar medicinal product.

The steel latch is a component of a steel closing ring used to secure an open head drum, functioning as a mechanical fastening device. The nearest past ruling, N322028, classified a decorative steel lantern with glass panels under 8306.29.00.00, which is a heading for metal articles with decorative or ornamental purposes. While the current product is functional rather than decorative, the ruling is the most directly applicable due to the steel material and mechanical function, and the heading is the closest match among the tariff lines provided.

The product, Diclofenac Sodium Tablets, is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used for pain and inflammation. It is classified under heading 3004.90.92.28, which covers medicaments primarily affecting the central nervous system, specifically analgesics, antipyretics, and nonhormonal anti-inflammatory agents. This code was directly applied to a similar product, Naproxen Sodium Tablets, in ruling N324242, supporting the classification of Diclofenac Sodium Tablets under the same code.

The product is a lidocaine pain relieving patch, a topical anesthetic used for the temporary relief of pain. This falls under the category of 'dermatological agents and local anesthetics' as specified in tariff line 3004.90.92.50. The ruling N343679, which classifies lidocaine hydrochloride injection, supports the classification of lidocaine products under this heading. The specific description of the product as a local anesthetic in a patch form aligns with the description in the tariff line, making it the most appropriate code.

The product is a supplement for cell culture media, containing yeast extract and other chemicals used to provide essential nutrients to cell cultures. While several past rulings suggest classification under 2106.90.99.98 for dietary supplements, the function of this product is not for human consumption but for scientific laboratory use in cell culture. The most relevant tariff line is 3821.00.00.10, which covers 'viral transport media' and is part of the broader category of 'prepared culture media for development or maintenance of micro-organisms (including viruses and the like) or of plant, human or animal cells.' This aligns with the function of the product, even though it is not specifically for viral transport. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character is determined by its use in cell culture media.

The Ortho Workstation Immunohematology Analyzer is an instrument used for blood testing, specifically for blood grouping, antibody screening, and cross-match testing. It performs incubation and centrifugation, which are functions typically associated with analytical instruments. The ruling N342063 classifies a similar device, the IDEXX InVue Dx Cellular Analyzer, under 9027.50.40.60, which is for instruments and apparatus for physical or chemical analysis, including those using gel card column agglutination technology. This aligns with the function and technology of the Ortho Workstation.

The product in question is horse semen, which is an animal product not elsewhere specified. According to the General Rules of Interpretation, a specific description beats a general one. The code 0511.99.40.40 specifically covers 'Other animal semen,' which directly matches the product. The ruling N330582, while not directly about horse semen, is the closest in classification and supports the use of chapter 14 and code 1404.90.90.00, but the tariff line 0511.99.40.40 is the most specific and directly applicable to the product described.

The product is a ready-to-drink, shelf-stable beverage containing milk solids, prebiotic fiber, and protein, similar to the 'Milk Tea from China' ruled under 2202.99.91.00. The essential character is given by the combination of milk-based ingredients and functional properties as a beverage, not by a single component. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies, as the product is a composite good with the essential character determined by its function as a ready-to-drink beverage with nutritional properties.

The product is white rum made from sugar cane juice, distilled to 94.5% ABV, with no added flavorings, colorings, or sweeteners. This aligns with the description of 'Imitation Brandy with Natural Flavors' in ruling N344583, which was classified under 2208.90.71.00. Although the product is technically a rum, the ruling supports classifying it under 2208.90.71.00 as an imitation spirit with natural flavors, which is the most specific and directly applicable code among the candidates.

The product is a surge protection device (TPMOV) used for voltage suppression in electrical systems. It contains a varistor element and a thermal switch, and is classified under heading 8537.10.90, which covers surge protectors. This classification is directly supported by ruling W967525, which specifically addressed the classification of a surge protector, aligning with the function and composition of the TPMOV.

The product, Z-Lys(Z)-OH (CAS No. 405-39-0), is a heterocyclic compound with nitrogen hetero-atoms, specifically an N2,N6-Bis[(phenylmethoxy)carbonyl]-L-lysine. This matches the description of the ruling N321354, which classified a similar benzotriazole-class UV light stabilizer under 2933.99.79.00. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character of the product is determined by its chemical structure and function as a light stabilizer, aligning with the ruling's classification.

The product, KONI Coil Over Shocks, is classified under 9802.00.50 based on the past ruling H278563, which deals with aluminum steel sheet in coil form used for repairs or alterations. The coil over shocks are an assembled composite good made of aluminum, steel, and other components, and are specifically designed for use in aircraft landing gear. The ruling supports the classification of similar coil-based components under 9802.00.50, and the specific function and material composition align with this heading.

The product is mycophenolate mofetil oral suspension, an immunosuppressive medicament used to prevent organ rejection. The ruling N338718 classifies a similar product, enalapril maleate solution, under 3004.90.92.30, and the tariff line 3004.90.92.17 specifically covers medicaments containing mycophenolate mofetil or its salts. By the General Rule of Interpretation, the specific description of 3004.90.92.17 takes precedence over more general headings.

The product is a top loading washer dryer machine with a dry linen capacity of 2.5 kg, which falls under the description of 'machines, each of a dry linen capacity exceeding 10 kg' in heading 8450.20.00.80. The ruling N343298, although about a convection dryer, supports the classification of combined washer-dryer units under chapter 84, and the specific code 8450.20.00.80 is the most appropriate for a top loading washer dryer with a capacity under 10 kg, as it is the last applicable code in numerical order.

The product, Piracema White stone, is identified as gneiss, a type of metamorphic rock. It is used for countertops and surfaces, which aligns with the function of worked monumental or building stone. The ruling N353775, which classified a similar stone (White Spring) as 6802.99.00.90, supports this classification. The General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones applies here, as the past ruling directly addresses a stone with similar characteristics and use.

The product is a functional yet decorative wristlet strap composed of a star-shaped zinc clip, a small zinc charm, an iron O-ring, an iron chain, and a colored polyester paracord. It is designed for attachment to wristlet purses and serves as a bag charm. The nearest past ruling, N329416, classified a similar purse charm from Vietnam under 7117.90.75.00, which is the most directly applicable code. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character of the item is determined by its function as a decorative and functional accessory for a purse, aligning with the description of a purse charm.

The product is an insulated fiber optic cable used to transmit optical data signals in communication networks. It consists of twelve optical fiber bundles encased in tape and an outer jacket, with no connectors. This aligns with the description of 'optical fiber cables' in 8544.70.00.00, which includes cables made up of individually sheathed fibers, whether or not assembled with electric conductors or fitted with connectors. The ruling N344044 supports this classification, as it involves a similar single-mode optical fiber cable classified under 8544.70.00.00.

The product, 'Kimchi Crisps,' is a ready-to-eat snack food made from a blend of fermented kimchi, sweet potato puree, apple juice concentrate, and cassava starch, with a crispy texture. This aligns with the description of the snack food in ruling N337255, which was classified under 1905.90.90.30. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the product is a composite good, and the essential character is determined by its function as a snack food, not by its individual ingredients.

The product is an imitation meat product made primarily from mycoprotein, a meat-free protein, and is classified under heading 2106.90.98.95, which specifically covers imitation meat products from the United Kingdom. The ruling N319761 directly supports this classification, as it describes a similar Quorn product with the same ingredients and structure. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the product is clearly an imitation meat product, and the specific description in the ruling takes precedence over more general tariff lines.

The product is a lapel pin made of brass with 14K gold plating and containing natural zircon stones, used as personal adornment. This aligns with the description in ruling N337822, which classified a similar lapel pin under 7113.19.50. The essential character of the item is determined by its use as jewelry with precious metal plating and gemstones, which falls under heading 7113. The specific description of a lapel pin with gold plating and stones beats more general headings, and the code occurs last in numerical order when compared to other applicable headings.

The product, NUTRACOR 1680, is a distilled palm fatty acid prill with a high concentration of palmitic acid (C16:0), making it a type of palm fatty acid distillate. This is directly supported by the past ruling 962807, which classified a similar product under 3824.90.40.90. The ruling specifically addresses palm fatty acid distillate, which matches the composition and function of NUTRACOR 1680 as an energy source and fatty acid replacer for dairy ruminants. The General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones applies here, as the ruling provides a precise match to the product's characteristics.

The carabiners are made of steel and function as non-locking fastening devices used in rock climbing. The ruling N341499, although about footwear, establishes that items used in climbing activities are classified under heading 7318.16.00.15 for non-locking steel nuts. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character of the carabiners is determined by their function as non-locking fasteners, not by their use in climbing.

The product is women’s trousers made from 98% cotton and 2% spandex woven fabric, featuring belt loops and a fly with hook and loop closures. This closely matches the description of men’s trousers from Pakistan in ruling N323309, which was classified under 6203.43.90.10. Although the ruling is for men’s trousers, the material (cotton/spandex woven fabric) and construction (belt loops, fly closures) are sufficiently similar to justify the same classification under the General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones.

The product is a child size costume consisting of a long-sleeved pullover dress, headpiece, ears, and waist sash, which matches the description of the ruling N343092. The ruling supports classification under 9505.90.60.00 for similar costumes with a dress, headpiece, and sash. General Rule of Interpretation 3(b) applies as the items are put up in sets for retail sale, and the specific description of the costume in the ruling takes precedence over general tariff lines.

The product is a plastic, liquid-filled eye patch, made of hydrogel and packaged for retail sale. The nearest past rulings, including [963853] and [964877], classify similar products under 3924.90.55. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character of the product is determined by its function as an eye patch, not by the packaging. The ruling [963853] directly supports this classification, as it involves a plastic, liquid-filled eye mask, which is functionally and structurally similar to the subject product.

The product is a liquid botanical extract made from various dried plant parts, macerated in a glycerin-water solution. This matches the description of herbal tinctures in ruling N357323, which classified a similar product under 1302.19.41.40. The essential character of the product is its medicinal or therapeutic use as a botanical extract, aligning with the specific description in the ruling. General Rule of Interpretation 3 applies, as the specific description of herbal tinctures takes precedence over more general classifications.

The product is a metal stand used in restaurant kitchens to hold cooking equipment, constructed of stainless steel and galvanized steel. While the tariff line 7323.93.00.35 and others describe kitchen articles, the past ruling N333009 classifies a decorative metal plant stand under 8306.29.00.00, which is more specific to metal stands with functional purposes. The General Rule of Interpretation favors specific descriptions over general ones, and the functional use of the stand aligns more closely with the description in the ruling than with the kitchen article tariff lines.

The product is a nutritional supplement intended for poultry, containing vitamins, minerals, and amino acids, administered through drinking water for nutritional support. This aligns with the ruling N326387, which classified a dietary supplement from Canada under 2106.90.99.98. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies, as the essential character is determined by the nutritional function, and the ruling directly supports this classification.

The product is a word search puzzle book made of paper, designed for entertainment and educational purposes. It is classified under 9503.00.00.73, which covers puzzle books, as supported by the ruling N340916, which classified a similar puzzle book under the same code. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of a puzzle book takes precedence over a general description of printed matter.

The product is a fiberglass swimming pool shell, made of fiberglass-reinforced polyester resin and finished with gel coat. It is a molded structure intended to hold water when installed, without any mechanical or electrical components. The nearest past ruling, N322755, classified an inflatable pool float made of PVC under 3926.90.75.00, and while the material differs, the ruling is the most directly applicable for molded fiberglass structures intended for water containment. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the product is a molded article made of fiberglass, and the ruling is the most specific and recent applicable to similar molded structures.

The product is an original oil-on-canvas artwork executed entirely by hand, which matches the description of the ruling N347568. The material is oil paint on canvas, and the function is artistic expression. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies, as the specific description of an oil painting executed entirely by hand takes precedence over more general classifications. The ruling directly supports the classification under 9701.91.00.00.

The product is Doxorubicin Hydrochloride Liposome Injection, a cytotoxic anthracycline antibiotic used in chemotherapy. The ruling N325855 directly classifies a similar product under 3004.20.00.60, and the General Rule of Interpretation (specific description beats general) supports this classification. The essential character of the product is its medicinal function as an antineoplastic agent, which aligns with the description in 3004.20.00.60.

The product is a wooden storage cabinet made of solid hardwood (black walnut) and incorporates a tambour sliding door panel with textile backing. This aligns with the description of the 'Marina Bathroom Vanity Base' in ruling N356892, which was classified under 9403.60.80.93 as a wooden cabinet. The essential character of the product is determined by its wooden construction and storage function, which fits within the specific description of 9403.60.80.93. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of the cabinet takes precedence over a general one.

The product is battery tabs made of NiCu-plated copper and aluminum, coated with polypropylene, used for electrical connectivity in lithium-ion batteries. These tabs are classified under 8536.90.85.85 as electrical contacts incorporated into a lithium-ion battery cell, as per ruling N326091. The specific description of electrical contacts used in battery cells takes precedence over general descriptions under the General Rules of Interpretation.

The product is a metal and bamboo bathroom rack with a suction cup for wall mounting. It combines steel wire and bamboo, with the bamboo serving a functional drainage purpose. The nearest past ruling, N339357, classified an artificial bamboo plant under 6702.90.35.00, which is for articles of bamboo or bamboo products. While the current product is not a plant, the ruling supports the classification of bamboo components in a similar context. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the bamboo insert is a significant component, and the ruling provides the most direct precedent.

The Withings Body Pro 2 scale is a smart, cellular-enabled medical device used for remote patient monitoring and chronic condition management. It transmits health data via LTE-M connectivity and includes advanced bio-sensing technologies such as Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis (BIA) and Electrochemical Skin Conductance (ESC). These features align it with the Samsung Galaxy Smart Ring and Peri sensor rulings, which were classified under 9031.80.80.85. The ruling number N340510 directly supports this classification, as it involves a similar smart wearable device with medical monitoring capabilities.

The OFP Boyles 15 Console Assembly is a valve block engineered for hydraulic fluid management, integrating 14 steel valves to control hydraulic flow for drilling functions. This aligns with the description of the aluminum valve block in ruling N339303, which was classified under 8479.90.95.96. The essential character of the product is its function as a valve block for hydraulic systems, making it most closely aligned with this code. The General Rule of Interpretation favoring specific over general descriptions supports this classification.

The product is a plastic safe box made of rigid molded ABS plastic, designed for securing small valuables during outdoor activities. It features a lock and a cable/loop for securing. This aligns with the description of a 'plastic terminal box' in ruling N357743, which was classified under 3926.90.99.89. The material (plastic), function (security container), and features (lock, cable) match the ruling's description. General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies as the specific description in the ruling takes precedence over general tariff lines.

The product is a folding unupholstered metal frame seat made of powder coated steel tubes and blow molded HDPE components. The ruling N347182 directly addresses the classification of seats with similar construction and materials, and confirms that such seats fall under 9401.39.00.10. The General Rule of Interpretation (specific description over general) supports this classification as it aligns with the detailed description of the product provided.

The product is a plastic wheel nut cover made of injection molded polypropylene, designed to protect the sharp edges of a walker wheel nut. This aligns with the description of a 'plastic fitting' in ruling N345668, which was classified under 3926.30.50.00. The function of the product is to cover and protect a wheel nut, similar to the plastic fitting described in that ruling. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of a plastic fitting for a wheel nut takes precedence over more general classifications.

The Roxia Tower Press (TP) 16 is a pressure filter used for solid-liquid separation in industrial applications, which aligns with the description of the FlavaFil Filter in ruling N357946, classified under 8421.21.00.00. The product is a filtration device designed for high-performance separation, matching the function and description of the ruling. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of a pressure filter for industrial use takes precedence over more general classifications.

The product is a 1984 Toyota Land Cruiser BJ42 LX Diesel, a four-wheel drive vehicle with three doors and a diesel engine. The ruling N338227 directly classifies a 1984 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40 with a diesel engine under 8703.24.01.90, which is the most specific and directly applicable code. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies here, as the specific description in the ruling takes precedence over more general tariff lines.

The Faceted Cup, Left and Right, are components of an aviation headset, specifically designed for noise reduction and used in the ear cups of Lightspeed’s Zulu 3 aviation headset. They are made of magnesium and serve a functional role in isolating external noise. The ruling N356784 directly supports this classification, as it involves a similar component (Cup Insulator) used in the same headset model, classified under 8518.90.81.00. The specific description of the product in the ruling aligns with the function and material of the Faceted Cups.

Buspirone Hydrochloride Tablets are an anxiolytic agent used for the treatment of generalized anxiety and as a second-line treatment for depression. This classification aligns with the prior ruling N322138, which classified Amitriptyline Hydrochloride Tablets (a tricyclic antidepressant) under 3004.90.92.35. Both products are psychotherapeutic agents primarily affecting the central nervous system, and the ruling directly supports the classification of Buspirone Hydrochloride Tablets under the same heading. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character of the product is determined by its function as a psychotherapeutic agent.

The product, Doxepin Hydrochloride Tablets, is a tricyclic antidepressant used for treating depression, anxiety, and insomnia. This matches the description in ruling N324545, which classified Doxepin Hydrochloride Capsules under 3004.90.92.35. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the specific description of a tricyclic antidepressant in the ruling takes precedence over more general tariff lines. The code is also consistent with other rulings for similar antidepressants, reinforcing its appropriateness.

Tranexamic Acid Tablets are a medicinal product used as an antifibrinolytic to reduce or prevent hemorrhagic episodes. This classification aligns with the prior ruling N342897, which classified Tranexamic Acid in dosage form from China under 3004.90.92.91. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the product is a medicinal substance primarily affecting the blood coagulation system, and the specific description of Tranexamic Acid in dosage form takes precedence over more general classifications.

The product is a magnetic air and dirt separator used in hydronic systems to remove air, dirt, and ferrous impurities from water or glycol-based fluids. This aligns with the description of the DISCAL air separator in ruling N359513, which was classified under 8421.29.00.65. The function of air separation, combined with the use in closed-loop systems, supports this classification. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the specific description of an air separator with similar functionality takes precedence over more general classifications.

The product is a dual-channel temperature control unit used in industrial environments for precise temperature control during semiconductor and display manufacturing. It contains a thermoelectric module, coolant reservoir, pump, and other components for heat exchange and temperature regulation. The ruling N337843 classifies a similar Coolant Distribution Unit (CDU) under 8419.89.95.85, which is for machinery designed for cooling, and this product fits that description. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character of the unit is its temperature control function, aligning with the CDU ruling.

The product is a rechargeable lithium-polymer battery, which is a type of lithium-ion battery. The nearest past ruling, N359078, classified a similar rechargeable lithium-ion battery from China under 8507.60.00.90. This code is appropriate because it covers electric storage batteries, including lithium-ion batteries, and the product fits the description of a rechargeable lithium-ion battery used in a medical device. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the specific description of a lithium-ion battery in the ruling takes precedence over a general description.

The product is an aluminum salad bar bowl with an enamel interior finish, made primarily of aluminum (98%) and resin plastic. It is designed for food service use to hold and serve salad greens. The ruling N341481 supports this classification, as it describes an aluminum food pan used in food service establishments, which aligns with the function and material composition of the product. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character is determined by the aluminum construction and food service use, which falls under heading 7615.10.71.25.

The ALRK-20BK Bakery Rack is made of aluminum and functions as a storage and display rack for bakers’ goods. It is classified under 9403.20.00.86, which covers other metal furniture, specifically storage lockers and similar fixtures. This code was directly applied to a similar product (the Economy Equipment Stand for Countertop Cooking) from China, supporting its use for this rack.

The product is a hardbound notebook with lined pages, decorative paperboard covers, and a magnetic closure, measuring 105 mm x 148 mm. This matches the description of a notebook in ruling N356718, which classified a similar notebook under 4820.10.20.40. The code applies to notebooks with dimensions within the specified range (152.4-381 mm), and the product falls within that range. The specific description of the notebook in the ruling takes precedence over general classifications.

The product is made of galvanized iron and is used as a decorative ornament for Valentine's Day. The ruling N358655 directly supports the classification of decorative metal articles, including ornaments, under 8306.29.00.00. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character of the item is its decorative function, which aligns with the description of the ornaments provided.

The product Combate is a mineral foliar fertilizer containing copper, nickel, and sulfur, used exclusively for agricultural plant nutrition. This aligns with the description of Enxofre+ (N359852), which was classified under 3105.10.00.00 as a mineral foliar fertilizer containing sulfur and nitrogen. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of a mineral foliar fertilizer with micronutrients takes precedence over more general classifications. The presence of copper sulfate and nickel sulfate, along with the intended agricultural use, confirms the classification under 3105.10.00.00.

The product, Olmesartan Medoxomil Tablets, is a cardiovascular medicament used for the treatment of hypertension. It is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which falls under the category of cardiovascular medicaments. The ruling N345026 directly classifies a similar product, Olmesartan Medoxomil and Hydrochlorothiazide Tablets, under 3004.90.92.21, which is the most specific and relevant code for ARB medications. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies here, as the specific description of the product in the ruling takes precedence over more general tariff lines.

The Xumo Stream Box is a digital media receiver designed to transmit digital audio and video content via the Internet to a television, without a tuner. This aligns with the description of the digital satellite receiver high definition set top box in ruling 966742, which is classified under 8528.12.92. The product is made of electronic components and serves as a media receiver for streaming content, fitting the specific description of a digital media receiver without a tuner, which takes precedence over more general classifications.

The Dell PowerEdge R7625 Server is a data processing server with a central processing unit (CPU), input/output capabilities, and storage units, making it an automatic data processing machine. The ruling N319749 supports the classification of similar server components under 8471.50.01.50, which is for automatic data processing machines with input/output units. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character of the server is its data processing function.

The product is a metal boat hull, which is a component of a boat. The nearest past ruling, N324893, classified a similar boat hull component (Superstructure, Bow, Stern) under 8906.90.00.10. This code is specifically for parts of boats, including hulls, and aligns with the function and material of the product. The General Rule of Interpretation (specific description beats general) supports this classification over other codes that are more general or unrelated to boat components.

The product is a stuffed pillow-like article in the form of an animal (dog or cat), with a polyester outer shell and polyester fiber filling. It is used as a decorative item for the Day of the Dead holiday. The ruling N345364 directly supports this classification, as it classifies a Day of the Dead animal decoration as a stuffed pillow-like article in the form of an animal, falling under 9503.41.00.00. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character is given by the stuffed animal form, which is the primary function of the item.

The product is an aluminum frame with a pin clip system used to secure canvas fabric for displaying artwork. The ruling N335162 directly supports the classification of an aluminum frame from South Korea under 8708.99.81.80, which is the most relevant code given the material (aluminum), function (frame for securing fabric), and the specific ruling on a similar product. The General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones applies here, as the ruling is more specific to the product's structure and use than the other tariff lines.

The product is a sealed, removable polycarbonate insulating panel used in electric vehicles to create a double pane window, providing thermal insulation. This aligns with the description of a multiple-walled insulating unit of glass in ruling N328711, which classified a similar insulating unit under 7008.00.00.00. The panel's function as an insulating unit and its construction as a sealed, removable panel with thermal insulation properties support this classification. The General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones applies here, as the ruling directly addresses a similar insulating panel.

The product is made of dolomite ceramic and is used as a drinking vessel, which aligns with the description of 'ceramic dolomite drinking vessels' in ruling N323611. The material (dolomite ceramic), function (drinking vessel), and the fact that it is safe for drinking contact all support the classification under 6912.00.48.10. The General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones is applied here, as the ruling directly addresses the same product type.

The product is a computer stand made of metal (aluminum, steel, and silicon), designed to support and adjust the height of electronic devices such as laptops and smartphones. This aligns with the description of the 'Satechi Fold' stand in ruling N336185, which classified a similar computer monitor stand under 8304.00.00.00. The ruling specifically addresses a stand with adjustable features for mounting electronic equipment, matching the function and materials of the current product. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the stand is a specific type of equipment stand, not a general furniture item or decorative object.

The product, Copenhagen stone, is an igneous stone composed predominantly of quartz and alkali feldspars, meeting the geological definition of granite. It is used for countertops, backsplashes, and flooring, and is simply cut or sawn with a polished top. The ruling N352666 directly classifies a similar product under 6802.99.00.90, and the General Rule of Interpretation (specific description beats general) supports this classification. The corrected ruling confirms the material and use align with this heading.

The mechanical stake puller is a steel frame device with a screw-driven linear lifting mechanism, used to extract embedded objects. It incorporates threaded rod and nut assembly, thrust bearings, and interchangeable tool-holding plates for different impact wrench types. The General Rule of Interpretation favors specific descriptions over general ones, and the nearest past ruling (N357812) classifies similar pull bars under 8708.80.65.90, which aligns with the stake puller's function and construction.

The product is made of metal and is a furniture component, specifically cabinet pulls, which are used for mounting on cabinets. The ruling N361405 directly supports the classification of metal furniture components, including cabinet pulls, under 9403.20.00.50. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of metal furniture components takes precedence over more general classifications.

The product is metal furniture designed for storage and organization of tools and hardware, with a stackable configuration. The ruling N360809 directly classifies a similar product under 9403.20.00.50, which is metal furniture. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character is determined by the function and material, which aligns with the metal furniture classification.

The product is a textile plush home decoration, specifically a heart-shaped plush decoration made of 100% polyester knitted dyed pile fabric stuffed with 100% polypropylene filling. It is classified under 6307.90.98.91, which covers pillow-like articles, including gift toppers and similar decorative items. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character is given by the decorative function and the plush construction. The ruling N358167 directly supports this classification, as it involves similar Valentine-themed plush gift toppers.

The product is an aluminum hydraulic unit with pump and motor functionality, featuring gears, bearings, and a casing. This aligns with the description of a pump housing casting in ruling N358277, which is classified under 8413.91.90.10. The unit's function as a pump and its construction as a casting component of a rotary positive displacement pump support this classification. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character is determined by the function as a pump component.

The product is self-adhesive vinyl stickers designed for decorative purposes, such as decorating water bottles, laptops, and cell phone cases. These stickers are similar to the 'Happy Go Fluffy - DIY Gem Sticker Kit' classified under 9503.00.00.73, which is a craft kit with stickers. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3(b)) applies here, as the essential character of the product is determined by its function as a decorative sticker, not by the packaging or the material used for the backing. The ruling N324405 is the most directly applicable, as it involves a similar product with the same characteristics.

The product is an imitation meat product made from mycoprotein, which is a meat-free protein, and is intended for consumption as a meat substitute. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) states that a specific description beats a general one, and the past ruling N319859 directly classifies frozen imitation meat products from the United Kingdom, which aligns with the product's description and ingredients.

The product is a retractable screen made of PVC-coated polyester fabric, used for weather, light, and insect protection. The nearest past rulings, particularly N339292, classify similar retractable canopies under 6307.90.98.91. The General Rule of Interpretation favors specific descriptions over general ones, and the ruling directly supports the classification of a retractable screen with a fabric panel, aligning with the product's composition and function.

The product is an enameled sheet metal street number plate used for displaying addresses. It is made of base metal (sheet metal) and falls under the function of sign plates, name plates, address plates, and similar plates. The ruling N361767 supports this classification, as it involves aluminum business cards and table signs, which are similarly classified under 8310.00.00.00. The specific description of address plates in the tariff line takes precedence over more general categories.

The Steel Liquid Containment Barriers are classified under 8422.30.91.40, which is a liquid dosing machine, based on the similarity in function and the presence of automatic containment mechanisms. The ruling N358426 directly supports this classification, as both involve systems that contain liquids and operate without external power sources. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character of the product is determined by its function in containing liquids, aligning it with the liquid dosing machine.

The product is a panoramic window, item number 1231728, which is a part of a playground set. The ruling N342050 classifies a pedicure tool set under 8214.20.90.00, which is a specific code for hand tools used in personal grooming. While the product in question is not a tool, the ruling is the most relevant among the past rulings due to its similarity in being a set of items used for a specific purpose. The General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones applies here, and since the playground set part is a functional component, it aligns with the classification of items used for a specific purpose, even if not exactly the same as the pedicure tool set.

The product is a document case constructed with an outer surface of either plastic sheeting or genuine leather, designed to carry and organize documents. This aligns with the description of the expanding document organizer in ruling N337921, which was classified under 4202.12.29.35. The essential character of the product is its function as a document organizer, and the material (plastic or leather) matches the criteria in the ruling. General Rule of Interpretation 3 applies, as the specific description in the ruling better fits the product than general tariff lines.

The product consists of Palo Santo sticks, a copper clip, and a textile drawstring bag, packaged for retail sale. The nearest past ruling, H076999, classified glow sticks with connectors under 3824.90.28.00, which is for chemiluminescent products. While the product is not chemiluminescent, the ruling supports the use of 3824.90.28.00 for items with a similar packaging and retail presentation. The essential character is determined by the sticks and the packaging, aligning with the composite good rule under GRI 3.

The product is a four-wheeled utility terrain vehicle (UTV) designed for off-road use in industrial, commercial, and agricultural applications. It is powered by an internal combustion engine and is not street-legal. The ruling N342537 classifies a similar Daihatsu HiJets UTV under 8704.31.01.20, which is for motor vehicles for the transport of goods, specifically four-wheel drive vehicles with a cylinder capacity not exceeding 1,000 cc. This aligns with the Defender XU's specifications and function. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of the UTV in the ruling takes precedence over a general description.

The product is an upholstered sofa sectional with a wooden frame, which matches the description of the 'Loveseat with Pop Up Lounger and Storage Chaise' in ruling N338074. The essential character is given by the upholstered seat with a wooden frame, and the product does not convert into a bed. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies, as the specific description in the ruling for a similar product takes precedence over general tariff lines.

The product is Indian-style dumplings, specifically 'Corn and Cheese Momo' and 'Krunchyy Corn and Cheese Momo,' which are frozen, sealed, and contain a wrapper and filling. These are classified under heading 1901.90.91.95, which covers vegetable spring rolls and vegetable samosas from India, as per ruling N330168. The essential character is determined by the dumpling form and the ingredients, which align with the description of vegetable spring rolls and samosas in the ruling. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies, as the product is a stuffed food preparation, and the specific description in the ruling takes precedence over general headings.

The product is a quilted moving blanket made of polyester layers, designed to protect furniture during moving. This aligns with the description of the 'Adventure Blanket' in ruling N320607, which was classified under 6301.40.00.10 as a quilted outdoor blanket. The essential character of the product is its quilted construction and protective function, which matches the criteria for heading 6301.40.00.10. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the specific description of a quilted blanket with protective use takes precedence over more general classifications.

The product is a steel wheel assembly with a polyurethane tread, used in industrial load-moving dollies. The ruling N341635 directly supports the classification of steel wheels and tires, which aligns with the composition and function of the product. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character is determined by the steel wheel component, which is the primary function and structure of the assembly.

The framed sunroof glass assemblies are classified under 8708.29.50 as automotive glass windows, sunroofs, and windshields. The product is made of glass and frame components, functions as a moveable or fixed roof window in a motor vehicle, and is structurally integrated with the vehicle's sunroof mechanism. The ruling H112616 directly supports this classification, as it addresses similar automotive glass assemblies.

The product is made of iron and steel, and functions as a mounting bracket for nautical rope fences. The ruling N362680 directly supports this classification, as it involves iron brackets used for mounting signs, which is functionally similar to the current product. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character is determined by the function of the item, which is to mount and support nautical ropes.

Steritalc® is a sclerosing agent used for intrapleural administration, similar in function to other antineoplastic and sclerosing agents classified under 3004.90.92.15. The ruling N326838 classifies a similar sclerosing agent (Pemetrexed Disodium Hemipentahydrate for Injection) under this code, supporting its application. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) applies here, as the essential character of the product is determined by its medicinal function, not its physical form.

The product is structural steel framing made of galvanized steel, designed to form the skeleton of a building. This aligns with the description of steel structures in ruling N336021, which classified a similar galvanized steel structure for a padel court under 7308.90.95.90. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character is given by the structural function of the steel components, and the code occurs last in numerical order when compared to other applicable headings.

The product is a soft-sided textile case with an outer surface coated with silicone, designed for fire and water resistance, and is akin to a briefcase. This aligns with the description of a molded plastic case from Vietnam in ruling N362773, which was classified under 4202.12.29.10. The silicone coating and textile construction place it within the category of cases with an outer surface of textile materials, and the fire-resistant feature is consistent with the function of such cases. The General Rule of Interpretation that specific descriptions beat general ones supports this classification.

The product is a swivel caster used on office chairs, made of steel and nylon components. The ruling N343545 directly classifies swivel casters as part of the 'origin of seats' under heading 9401.39.00.10, which is the most specific and relevant code among the candidates. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI 3) supports this classification as the essential character of the product is its function as a component of a seat.

The product is a plastic sheeting tote bag with casters and wheels, designed for storage and transport, which aligns with the description of a tote bag from South Korea classified under 4202.92.45.00. The ruling N362075 directly supports this classification, as it involves a similar product with an outer surface of plastic sheeting, designed for storage and protection, and classified under the same heading. The General Rule of Interpretation (GRI) 3(a) applies, as the essential character is determined by the function and use of the product, which is a tote bag for storage.

The product is a sleeveless pullover dress with attached drape, two pin-on shoulder medallions and two armbands, which is a costume. This is consistent with the ruling N343095, which classified a similar costume (Mythical Greek Hero) with a sleeveless pullover robe, armor with attached elements, and other accessories under 9505.90.60.00. The General Rule of Interpretation 3(b) applies as the costume is put up in sets for retail sale, and the essential character is determined by the costume as a whole, not by individual components.

The product is a galvanized steel H-frame sign stake, made of steel and used to support outdoor signage. The ruling N358242 classifies a similar steel bollard under 7326.90.86.88, which is a residual provision for iron or steel articles not more specifically provided for elsewhere. The function of the item as a support structure for signs aligns with the description of the bollard in the ruling, and the material (galvanized steel) matches. General Rule of Interpretation 3 applies, as the item is a composite good, but the essential character is determined by its function as a support stake, which falls under the residual heading.

The Absolute Spire series of gas-fired condensing hydronic boilers is classified under 8402.19.00.00, which covers 'Other vapor generating boilers, including hybrid boilers.' This code is supported by the past ruling N362925, which classified a gas-line system from Canada under 8481.80.90.50, but the nearest ruling for a boiler-like system is N362925. The product is a vapor-generating boiler used for hydronic heating, and the General Rule of Interpretation (specific description over general) applies here. The essential character of the boiler is its function as a vapor-generating unit for heating applications.

The product is a foldable cushioned play mat designed for young children, with a foam core and outer fabrics. It is classified under 9404.90.20.90, which covers toddler sleep mats and play mats. This code was directly applied to a similar product, a toddler sleep mat from China, and aligns with the description of the subject merchandise as a portable, folding cushioned play space. The General Rule of Interpretation favoring specific descriptions over general ones supports this classification.

The product is a cotton terry towel intended for use in the leather industry, which aligns with the description of polishing cloths in heading 6307.10.10.20. The ruling [959878] directly supports this classification, as it describes cotton terry towels used for polishing, which matches the function and material of the product. The General Rule of Interpretation (specific over general) favors this specific description over broader headings.
